english.title: Cause / permit a taxi on Gatwick Airport to ply for hire / load passengers w/o authorisation or from unauthorised place
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[caused]_
(B)_[permitted]_

a taxi, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), to

(C)_[ply for hire]_
(D)_[load passengers]_

on Gatwick Airport - London without being authorised by Gatwick Airport Limited to do so and doing so from an authorised standing
english.legislation: Contrary to Byelaws 9(1) and 2(3) of the Gatwick Airport - London Byelaws 1996 and sections 63 and 64 of the Airports Act 1986.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: It shall NOT be an offence to load passengers in a public car park or at a distance of more than half a mile from the nearest of such authorised standings or, with the consent of a constable, traffic warden in uniform, or an airport official at any distance from such authorised standings.
